answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and as a result a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in basalt and karst recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 9 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the voyage. A 376 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
